method: All 36 page layouts inspected in 11 contact sheets; special glyph panels and N016 page 3 inspected at detailed resolution. This is not a claim that every page was read at full-page resolution in this input review.
observations: Only declared repeated headers and isolated page numbers are removed. Identification banners, source Magma code, references, tables and author addresses remain counted.
The 36 CMEX byte-12 form-feed decodings are visible vertical delimiter pieces and must remain counted as U+23D0, one character per visible piece.
Both N016 Type3 byte-136 characters are visible circular bitmap bullets and remain counted as U+2022. The independent audit checked the original 38 by 38 mask.
The 18 repaired encoded classes and 33 AGL exceptions agree with the actual outline or bitmap views. Unchanged ligature expansions follow the prespecified literal extraction convention.
All complete replacement papers and both complete printed program files are included. Graphics and formula layout are not assigned fabricated text costs.
